question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Prostration
solution:
The correct answer is: **Refreshment**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Prostration"** means a state of extreme physical or mental exhaustion or being completely overcome and helpless. It can also refer to lying stretched out on the ground in submission or adoration. (अत्यधिक थकावट या विनम्रता में झुकना)

 
 
• **Example:** After hours of hard labor in the field, the workers fell into complete prostration.
 
 
 
• **"Refreshment"** refers to the act of renewing energy or revitalizing oneself, often after exhaustion or fatigue. (ताजगी या ऊर्जा पुनः प्राप्त करना)
 
 
• **Example:** A cold drink provided much-needed refreshment after the long hike.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'Prostration'** is **'Refreshment'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Refreshment**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Impression** (प्रभाव): A lasting effect or mark created by someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:** Her speech left a strong impression on the audience.
 
 
 
• **Acridness** (तीखापन): Sharp or bitter taste or smell; harshness.
 
 
• **Example:** The acridness of the smoke made it hard to breathe.
 
 
 
• **Counterpart** (समकक्ष): A person or thing that is similar to another or complements it.
 
 
• **Example:** The CEO met with his counterpart from the rival company to discuss collaboration.
 
 

33:Tb0b,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
